Episode 216. The First Gold Fleet(1)
Stormstone.
That's the name Pheitel gave to the object he made to contain Gram's energy.
"Shouldn't we call it Thunderstone? All you did was contain Gram's energy in this object."
"Murakan, what's the point in naming it after my dead brother? It's right to use my name. Isn't that right, Boss? Besides, this now also serves as a device for my incarnation."
Pheitel was incarnating through the Stormstone after escaping the subspace of Cheongsae Highway.
Incarnation through Yulian could put a strain on his body. This type of incarnation was also a privilege of the gods who specialized in 'materializing' power.
The colleagues were amazed by Pheitel's tactics. Jet even felt threatened about his position.

Of course, his ulterior motives were quite obvious, but no one disliked Pheitel's diplomacy. Especially Ameris laughed, saying that Pheitel had a cute side, and Pheitel was already showing signs of following Ameris, calling her 'sister.'
"It doesn't matter what the name is. If Pheitel likes it, Stormstone would be better."
"As Jin says. It doesn't matter what you name it. Murakan, don't unnecessarily pester Pheitel."
"Hehe, Sister Ameris is indeed the best. Why didn't I come to Tikan earlier and just hide stupidly?"
The important thing was not the name but the use.

The residual energy of Gram contained a power that was astonishing even to Pheitel. Tuizard failed to show any significant performance even after receiving that power in full, but that was because he could not use Gram's power properly. Even if he had used it in full, it would have been the same result against Jin, Luna, and Runtia.

"After all, our boss is easy to talk to. Hmm, by the way, the reason I need my power is to complete the Golden Fleet, which was the old desire of the Myungwang tribe, and to liberate the Half-Gods and the remaining Myungwang tribes......"
Pheitel shivered for a moment, remembering the Half-Gods.

He had not fought on the central battlefield where the Myungwang tribe fought a war with the gods. He had only engaged in a few small-scale battles, and even then, he did not take active part in the front line.
However, he clearly witnessed the moment of his brother Gram's death at the hands of Ban. At that time, Ban gave the impression that he could never be defeated by any god.
"Haha, do we have to call those dreadful friends?"

"As I explained earlier, the underworld will soon disturb the mortal world. And even if my brothers return to the mortal world, they will not wage a reckless conquest war like they did then, so don't worry."

"That's true...... Well, there wouldn't be more reliable friends than the Myungwang tribe if they are on our side. I don't know how strong the underworld is, but it must be weaker than the Myungwang tribe in its heyday."
"Excuse me, Pheitel."
"You're disrespectful! You're neither the boss, nor Sister Ameris, nor Murakan, how dare you speak to me like that!"
Pheitel roared at Kwool's words. Kwool was annoyed and was about to snap back, but seeing Valeria's expression, he just clicked his tongue in his mind.
"……Um, sorry. Mr. Faitel, I was wondering if you understand the blueprints you're looking at right now."

[Well, yes, I should say that. As soon as I saw the blueprint, I understood it immediately. I had forgotten, but I remember vividly now. The final battle with the Myeongwang Tribe, where the God of Battle led the golden fleet. Even among our gods, a lot of attention was paid from the stage where the golden fleet began to be made.]
Faitel rummaged through his memories of that time for a moment.
[In the end, we couldn't stop the fleet from being completed, but we identified a fatal weakness in it. That's why we were able to win the war with the Myeongwang Tribe with such a little damage.]
"Weakness?"
The most surprised by that remark was Kwa-ul.

Although the blueprint of the golden fleet was incomplete, Kwa-ul thought it was the most perfect piece he had ever seen since he was born. Faitel was saying that there was a weakness in such a blueprint.

[The Myeongwang people perform a thing called resonance centered around the God of Battle. It is an act of strengthening the heart of the other members through the power of the God of Battle. The golden fleet's power drastically decreased when it couldn't receive that resonance of the God of Battle. Therefore, if we only isolated the God of Battle, the fleet itself was not a problem for the gods.]

"Ah……! Now I see. The golden fleet was a whole, not one! I've been working thinking each ship was an independent entity, that's why I had such a hard time. So the problem wasn't the flaw or the unfinished part of the design, but trying to complete it without the existence of the God of Battle?”

[You're not polite, but you're a very smart human, Kwa-ul. But your method was not wrong. Didn't I just say that, it's a weakness. Each ship should be individual, and there should be no problem with the performance even if it doesn't receive the resonance of the God of Battle.]
Jin agreed with Faitel's opinion.

What the Barmel Alliance needs now is not a defense force through a 'transcendent individual', but a weapon that can exert tremendous power even when used by ordinary people. Like the mana suction spray type all-weather acceleration cannon installed in Tikan. Anyone could operate the cannon as long as they knew how to use it.
"So, what should we do?"
Kwa-ul asked in a much more polite tone.

[It's simple. Adjust it to maximize the performance of the power without the resonance of the God of Battle. The Myeongwang Tribe of the past couldn't do that. But you found me well. Compared to making weapons for my contractors, it's a simple task.]
"So, can you solve it right away? Several Hearts of Light are prepared."

[No, it will take some time. If my power and strength are the power source, I can make it quickly, but as you can see, my condition is not good. If I divide my power more, it will be hard even to maintain this form. I can't even draw all the power of my main body for a reward.]
Therefore, the power of the golden fleet had to be made through the Heart of Light, the original necessary material.

Faitel added an explanation that it would take time to understand the characteristics of the Myeongwang Tribe in order to process the Heart of Light. The power of the storm god and the energy of the Heart of Light were similar only in appearance, but fundamentally different in power.
[However, I

think I can make at least one power source first through the storm stone. Unlike the Heart of Light, it doesn't require much study and understanding to process. Despite my hatred for it in my lifetime, I can process it quickly because it is the power of my brother.]
The reason why Faitel could hide in the tomb of Gram in the first place was because he could imitate his power.
Finding Faitel and gaining the residual energy of Gram, and making the first power source of the golden fleet through it, were all unexpected profits.
"How do you expect the performance of a ship with a storm stone as a power source, compared to the real golden fleet?"

[Compared to the flagship operated by the God of War at that time, it may not be the same, but it won't fall short of Cojek. If you apply the Red Owl's space-jump technology, there is no shortage in expressing it as the strongest. In addition, unlike the fleet of the God of War, there will be no change in performance regardless of who operates it.]
Though not the entire fleet was completed, having just one additional ship like this was like rain in a drought right now.
Furthermore, the task of processing the Heart of Light would also be solved if they just had time. By then, they would be manufacturing not just a ship but a fleet.
[I can convert the storm stone into the power source of the golden fleet in about fifteen days.]
"That's just when Ayura's manifestation is due. It's also the expected time when the full-scale transfer to the demonic world will start, so it's perfect."
When Jin seemed satisfied, Faitel cracked a grin.
[Kwa-ul, can you complete the rest of it excluding the power? It's very exciting to see our leader happy. It means I'm eager to work.]
Yulian and Caltor wanted to hide somewhere every time Faitel flattered them.
"It's enough. Finally, I can bear the first fruit of my long research...! Just like Valeria said, meeting Lord Faitel made it possible to make a golden fleet!"
"I just said it was a wish, but I didn't know the problem would be solved right away."
With the construction of the golden fleet starting, the biggest remaining task was liberating Lafrarosa.
However, Faitel said that he had no idea about liberating Lafrarosa either.

[I'm not reluctant to bring the Myeongwang Tribe back to the world. I will look at the liberation device that Kwa-ul and Valeria made before I start processing the storm stone, but it's better not to expect too much, leader. The chances are high that there is nothing I can do because Soldrett made that space.]
"If it's not disappointing, it's a lie, but just making a golden fleet is enough for Lord Faitel. Don't feel too pressured, just take a look."

[When you say that, I want to look harder. I'll go check and let you know right away if there's anything that seems helpful. And you can expect a lot from that golem named Eil. I'll try to apply it to the golem after studying the Heart of Light.]
"Oh, that's a more welcome story."
[Even though it's a manifestation through the vessel, Yulian and Caltor have to be close by, so can they take these guys?]
"Of course."
Kwa-ul, Valeria, and Faitel's party left the conference room. Faitel and Kwa-ul were humming a tune arm in arm.

'In just fifteen days, I can finally see the first golden ship. Now that the production of the fleet is just a matter of time, even if the demonic world is installed, I can afford to pull out the brothers.'

The magic knight squad has now risen to a level that can be deployed in actual combat, and the mass-produced Eil can also be enhanced according to Faitel's words. The war preparations of the Barmel Alliance were proceeding successfully.
Soon, Jin looked over the other reports on the table. They were all reports about the transfer fissures in the demonic world.
"Murakan."
"Oh, why?"
"As Sister Yona said, I should summon Tes and have a conversation. Let's meet with Lord Quicantel."
